title: Token count
description: Internal tokens.count contract (context-service POST /internal/v1/tokens/count). Body counting only; provider framing of the whole request and the final hard cap belong to 4.8.

CountMode.title: CountMode
CountMode.description: exact = local tokenizer identical to the provider (none exists for the 3.1 model). provider_estimate = provider count_tokens API (documented as an estimate). provider_reported = usage returned after a real request.

TokenCountFraming.title: TokenCountFraming
TokenCountFraming.description: What surrounds the counted text. single_user_message = one user message holding one text block; the count includes that minimal framing. provider_request = the input part (system, messages, tools, tool_choice, thinking) of one serialized provider request as sent (4.8 gate). plain_text = the text alone with no message framing (local llama.cpp tokenizer).

text.description: Text to count. Must be valid Unicode (no lone surrogates) and at most 1 MiB as UTF-8.

model_id.description: Optional; must equal the configured model. Omit to use it.

RequestTokenCountRequest.title: RequestTokenCountRequest
RequestTokenCountRequest.description: Internal POST /internal/v1/tokens/request (4.8). request is the exact outbound provider JSON object. Only verified framings are counted; anything else is TOKENIZER_UNAVAILABLE.

text_bytes.description: UTF-8 byte length of the counted text.

cached.description: true when served from the in-process cache keyed by sha256(model_id, text).

TokenCountSummary.title: TokenCountSummary
TokenCountSummary.description: Compact count embedded in other DTOs (bundles, plans). Never present a provider_estimate as exact.
